### Yield

```{r}
obs_yield <- pop$total_yield
names(obs_yield)[names(obs_yield) == "est"] <- "obs"
obs_yield$obs[obs_yield$is_proj] <- NA
obs_yield$is_proj <- NULL
obs_yield$unit <- NULL
pred_yield <- pop$total_yield_pred
names(pred_yield)[names(pred_yield) == "est"] <- "pred"
merge(obs_yield, pred_yield, by = c("year", "model")) |>
  plot_obs_pred(color = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(pred_yield, "Yield"))
```


### Numbers-at-age

```{r}
catch_plot <- obs_pred$catch
if ("fleet" %in% names(catch_plot)) {
  keys <- intersect(c("model", "year", "age", "is_proj"), names(catch_plot))
  catch_plot <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(catch_plot, interaction(catch_plot[keys], drop = TRUE)), function(d) {
    out <- d[1, c(keys, intersect("unit", names(d))), drop = FALSE]
    for (name in c("obs", "pred")) out[[name]] <- if (anyNA(d[[name]])) NA_real_ else sum(d[[name]])
    out
  }))
}
plot_age_year(catch_plot, plot = plot_obs_pred, frame = ~age, color = ~model,
                     colors = cols, ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(obs_pred$catch, "Catch"))
```


Row {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
catch_residuals <- obs_pred$catch
if ("fleet" %in% names(catch_residuals)) {
  catch_residuals$fleet <- as.character(catch_residuals$fleet)
  catch_residuals$fleet[is.na(catch_residuals$fleet)] <- "Fishery"
  catch_residuals$series <- interaction(catch_residuals$model, catch_residuals$fleet, sep = " / ", drop = TRUE)
}
resid_plots <- make_resid_plots(catch_residuals)
```
